title: Dealer, after-sales, and lumbar support
summary: Feedback in this topic spans dealer and after-sales support, seat and lumbar support, and safety support, with positive comments on service and support features but limited coherence because these subjects are mixed together.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise helpful dealer or tech support, good after-sales service, comfortable supportive seats, and appreciated safety support features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize poor general support and disappointing after-sales support.

mixed.summary: The mixed review notes that test-drive seats had comfortable lumbar support, but the single example is insufficient to explain the contrasting sentiment in the full review.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention missing lumbar or back support, unacceptable dealership support, and breakdown support contact, but the excerpts do not consistently show a clear overall sentiment assignment.

limitations: This cluster mixes several unrelated meanings of support, including dealer or after-sales support, seat or lumbar support, breakdown support, and safety support.
Many examples are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a single unified interpretation of the topic.
The mixed sentiment section has only one example, so the reason for the mixed assignment cannot be fully described from the supplied excerpt alone.
